summary: Verizon ABS II LLC filed an 8-K to report the engagement of Morgan, Lewis & Bockius LLP and Morris James LLP as counsel for its registration statement on Form SF-3 and to incorporate legal opinions into the registration for asset-backed securities transactions. The filing also references the issuance of $994,210,000 of 4.51% Class A-1a Notes and $75,000,000 of Compounded SOFR + 0% Class A-1b Notes by Verizon Master Trust, Series 2026-2. This is a routine structured finance current report, not a special situation.
